units.source_text: 冷泉帝闻此惊人消息，如在梦中。

en.t: When Emperor Reizei heard this astonishing news, he felt as though he were in a dream.
He turned it over in his mind again and again, and his thoughts became troubled and confused.

units.source_text: 他觉得此事对不起桐壶院在天之灵。

en.t: He felt that this matter wronged the departed spirit of the Kiritsubo Emperor.

units.source_text: 而使生父屈居臣下之位，实甚不孝。

en.t: And to leave his own father forced to remain in the position of a subject seemed truly unfilial.

units.source_text: 多方考虑，直到日晏之时，犹未起身。

en.t: He considered the matter from every side, and even when the day grew late, he still had not risen.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣闻知圣躬不豫，甚是吃惊，便前来探视。

en.t: When Genji, the Inner Minister, heard that His Majesty was unwell, he was greatly alarmed and came to visit him.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝一见其面，悲伤更难忍受，簌簌地掉下泪来。

en.t: As soon as Emperor Reizei saw his face, his grief became still harder to bear, and tears fell streaming down.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣以为他悼念母后，泪眼至今未干也。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, thought that the Emperor was mourning his mother and that his tearful eyes had still not dried.
